{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# First, check if any revenue values have commas (thousands separators)
print("Any revenue values contain commas?", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any())

# Parse revenue: remove commas, convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check: are there any rows with revenue = 999999.99?
print("Rows with revenue = 999999.99:", df[df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99].shape[0])

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders (if any)
completed_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Since no internal test orders exist, no need to filter further
# But verify: are there any rows with revenue_float == 999999.99 in completed?
internal_test_in_completed = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print("Internal test orders in completed set:", internal_test_in_completed.shape[0])

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_df['revenue_float'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}")"}
